body:
ordered a vial of een in may. it got sent out over a month after I paid. waited 2 more months and it never arrived. tried contacting support several times and never heard back. had to accept that I was never going to get the vial or my money back.

I can understand being overloaded with orders and I can understand long shipping delays but I really do not appreciate getting ghosted and never receiving my vial. will not be ordering from symphony labs again.

I’ve been waiting on my order since July. that’s more than 3 months!! symphony also isnt communicating, and when they are, it is not honest. i get ghosted a month at a time & when i get an email back its a new tracking code and a promise the order will be sent out ‘end of week’ or even ‘by end of day’. the newest tracking code from last week is still sitting on label created, and a promised refund hasnt been sent either.

the only reason i believe this isnt a scam is because of the trust valerie places in them. 

its kind of insane when otokonoko pharma has better comms than you. even though lilian from otokonoko takes weeks to reply to emails, at least she is honest if there are delays and tells me that she doesnt know when my order will be sent out. but i do know that it will be sent out. with symphony, i have only gotten false promises so far

Ordered one vial of 10ml een on September 11th, arrived on October 3rd. Took a bit to get here, but lovely packaging on the vial. Exterior shipping package was black and marked on the label as having peppermint oil. No complaints.

Ordered 2 things of Estradiol Enanthate and 2 things of Estradiol Enanthate showed up. Not a ton to really say, honestly. The vials themselves were both in bubble wrap separate. Stealth packaging says Peppermint Oil 10mg. Shove inside a stuffed animal or specifically a thermal/steel flask if taking around hot environments, helps fight harsh temp changes.

The Symphony Labs page itself was picked up by my rig as having CloufFlare trackers on it, which is basically plaguing everywhere now so that's whatever on TailsOS/Tor. Site will not function without Javascript being allowed.
They are legit!! Got mine within a month. I do live in europe, so I'm not complaining, and I'm very happy😊
great shipping, very communicative with tracking and issues, got 3 vials instead of one and with stealth cute packaging!
